THE PLANNED FREE CORE

A focused toolkit for your center.

Explore the intended free-core scope. Feature availability depends on the software’s implementation and release.

Patients & referralsTest catalogBilling & duesSamplesResults & reviewReportsDaily operationsAdministration
01

Patients & referrals

Unique patient IDs, search, duplicate warnings, history, and referring doctor records.

02

Test catalog

Tests, panels, parameters, prices, preparation notes, sample types, and reference ranges.

03

Billing & dues

Invoices, reasoned discounts, partial payments, manual payment records, reversals, and refunds.

04

Samples

Collection, barcode labels, test-level status, rejection reasons, and recollection history.

05

Results & review

Structured and narrative entry, configured flags, independent verification, release, and amendments.

06

Reports

Branded PDF reports, print and download, and narrative templates with optional attachments.

07

Daily operations

Collections, dues, pending work, referral summaries, turnaround time, and daily closing.

08

Administration

Editable staff permissions, audit history, Bangla and English, center settings, and CSV exports.

✳

Initial roles include administrator, receptionist, sample collector, technician, pathologist or radiologist, and accountant.
